topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Finding my work etched into skin, a tapestry of lines and color bound not by canvas but flesh—this defies the expected confines of my art. The permanence, the intimacy of it, sends a jolt through me. It’s as if my creation has taken on a life beyond my studio, a silent dialogue through ink between me and the bearer. This piece, once static, now moves with the rhythm of another’s existence. The boundaries between artist, art, and observer blur, redefining the essence of what I create. It’s a haunting reminder of art’s power to transcend, to intertwine with the very essence of humanity.
